test_chat_completion: test the litellm proxy chat completions endpoint by generating an API key and sending a chat request
test_streaming_chat_completion: test streaming chat completions with logprobs enabled using the AsyncOpenAI client against the litellm proxy
test_batch_chat_completions: test batch chat completions by sending a comma-separated model list to the litellm proxy endpoint
test_moderations_endpoint: test the litellm proxy moderations endpoint by sending input text and verifying the response contains results
test_embeddings: test the litellm proxy embeddings endpoint by generating a key and requesting embeddings for multiple models
